audits.title: An audit addressing the quality of prescribing sodium valproate in early intervention service
audits.standard: POMH-UK quality improvement programme standards for valproate prescribing
audits.setting: Four early intervention service hubs, Birmingham

cycle1.result: Target symptoms documented in all; 94% started as inpatients; 55% on off-licence preparation, 93% of these without documented rationale and 93% without discussion with patient; adequate community monitoring 74%.

audits.other_findings: Semi-sodium and sodium valproate used interchangeably despite not being bioequivalent; limited side-effect screening documented.
audits.citation: Aziz H, Khatri K, Upadhyaya S. An audit addressing the quality of prescribing sodium valproate in early intervention service. BJPsych Open. 2021;7(S1):S64-S64. doi:10.1192/bjo.2021.214.

audits.title: A quality improvement (QI) project to ensure females on valproate in a CMHT outpatient clinic, eput are registered on the valproate pregnancy prevention programme
audits.standard: MHRA guidance: women and girls of childbearing potential on valproate must be on a Pregnancy Prevention Programme; target 50% reduction in valproate prescriptions in this group
audits.setting: CMHT outpatient clinic, EPUT, with local GP surgeries

cycle1.result: 4/25 registered on the Pregnancy Prevention Programme; overall non-compliance 86%.

audits.intervention: Planned: electronic alert to prompt registration and yearly reminder for the annual risk acknowledgement form (under discussion).
audits.other_findings: Only 10 of 50 GP surgeries responded. A previous inpatient audit found none of 35 women of childbearing age on a pregnancy prevention plan.
audits.citation: Emmanuel A, Pillay P, Immadisetty V. A quality improvement (QI) project to ensure females on valproate in a CMHT outpatient clinic, eput are registered on the valproate pregnancy prevention programme. BJPsych Open. 2021;7(S1):S185-S186. doi:10.1192/bjo.2021.502.

audits.title: An Audit of Risk Acknowledgment of Valproate Use in Women (General Adult Psychiatry)
audits.standard: MHRA valproate guidance and Pregnancy Prevention Programme, including completed Annual Risk Acknowledgement Form
audits.setting: General adult psychiatry services, NHS Grampian

cycle1.result: 97% in contact with psychiatry services; only one patient (3%) had an ARAF completed and scanned to e-notes.

audits.intervention: Teams contacted by telephone and email and encouraged to complete the documentation.

cycle2.result: Completed ARAF in 21 patients; completion rose from 3% to 54%.

audits.other_findings: 66% of women in cycle 1 were aged 45–60.
audits.citation: Khattab E, Singh P. An Audit of Risk Acknowledgment of Valproate Use in Women (General Adult Psychiatry). BJPsych Open. 2022;8(S1):S161-S162. doi:10.1192/bjo.2022.456.

audits.title: Improving Valproate Prescribing Practices in Women of Childbearing Age: An Audit Cycle in a Psychiatric Inpatient Setting in Qatar
audits.standard: MHRA and NICE guidance on valproate in women of childbearing age
audits.setting: Hamad Medical Corporation psychiatric inpatient units

cycle1.result: Teratogenicity discussion documented in 1 (3%); benefits 7 (21%); side effects 3 (9%); pregnancy test 21 (65.6%); contraception education 0.

audits.intervention: Results disseminated in the department and educational sessions for doctors and pharmacists.

cycle2.result: Teratogenicity discussion 10 (47.6%); benefits 5 (23.8%); side effects 14 (66.7%); pregnancy test 19 (90%); contraception education 8 (38.1%).

audits.other_findings: Female bed capacity expanded during the re-audit. The audit prompted national guideline development and a QI project.
audits.citation: Alater A, Masoudi Z, Hamad S, Abdulla M, Iqbal Y. Improving Valproate Prescribing Practices in Women of Childbearing Age: An Audit Cycle in a Psychiatric Inpatient Setting in Qatar. BJPsych Open. 2025;11(S1):S214-S214. doi:10.1192/bjo.2025.10542.

audits.title: Compliance with Valproate Pregnancy Prevention Programme Documentation in Women of Reproductive Age: A Clinical Audit From a Tertiary Mental Health Service in the UAE
audits.standard: NICE and MHRA Valproate Pregnancy Prevention Programme guidance: documented counselling on teratogenic risk, contraception, pregnancy prevention and informed consent
audits.setting: Behavioural Sciences Unit, Al Ain Hospital, tertiary mental health service

cycle1.result: Full documented counselling on teratogenic risks with pregnancy prevention and contraception in 12 (24.5%); partial or none in 37 (75.5%); partner involvement 5 (10.2%); alternatives discussed 8 (16.3%).

audits.other_findings: Electronic prompts, templates, multilingual leaflets and clinician awareness were recommended, with a follow-up audit.
audits.citation: Almasri A, Ahmed S, Javaid S. Compliance with Valproate Pregnancy Prevention Programme Documentation in Women of Reproductive Age: A Clinical Audit From a Tertiary Mental Health Service in the UAE. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S306-S307. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11690.

audits.title: The Other Half of the Risk: Including Men in Valproate Safety Practice (An Audit of Compliance With Updated National Valproate Prescribing Guidelines)
audits.standard: 2024 MHRA valproate guidance including male patients: risk discussion, contraception advice, informed consent, MHRA materials, dual-signed ARAF
audits.setting: East Bromley Intensive Case Management in Psychosis team, Oxleas NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Risk discussions 37% (F 80%, M 17%); contraception advice 15% (F 80%, M 3%); informed consent 61% (F 80%, M 20%); MHRA materials 11% (F 60%, M 6%); dual-signed ARAF in eligible females 0%.

audits.intervention: Clinician education, 26 structured outpatient reviews, distribution of MHRA materials and a live ARAF tracking system.

cycle2.result: Male cohort: risk discussions 17%→87%; contraception advice 3%→83%; informed consent 20%→87%; MHRA materials 6%→83%; 100% of eligible females reviewed for second-consultant sign-off.

audits.other_findings: 13% of patients switched to alternative treatments after structured reviews and 9% were considering alternatives.
audits.citation: Nodehi A, Carter C, Horner C. The Other Half of the Risk: Including Men in Valproate Safety Practice (An Audit of Compliance With Updated National Valproate Prescribing Guidelines). BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S337-S338. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11825.
